text: AC3 cannot exclude file access: fmt transitively imports os - confirmed with go list -deps fmt - so any renderer that formats anything reaches os.ReadFile, and a check banning os would ban the renderer. AC2's working-tree clause is therefore closed by AC13's byte-identical test alone. Added a clause-to-criterion table. No test cites this because the spec is not built; the check is the command above, run by hand.
